digest.component_or_area: live Jira DC test harness for multi-project bridge scenarios
propositions: Fake transport masks real Jira behavior: non-existent project keys cause parse errors and abort the entire pass, not return empty
Live Cloud rehearsal against two shared projects cannot model three repo configurations plus empty and unknown project paths with throwaway projects
Multi-project rehearsal must verify cross-project contamination is impossible: each preview mutation set must contain only targets in the intended project with empty intersection against all others
Unknown or misconfigured project keys must fail closed (pass errors, writes nothing) rather than silently degrade
Ephemeral DC harness with admin-provisioned scratch projects per run supports reproducible, CI-verified rehearsal with cleanup on all exit paths via session-scoped finalizers

All nine acceptance criteria (provisioning, ingestion, routing, isolation, repo configs, cross-project guards, fail-closed behavior, preview validation, CI success, cleanup) must pass in the jira-dc-harness job
